title: Angry Lands, Brave Adventurers, and Other Decks for Vorthos

entities.name: Liliana Vess
entities.description: Planeswalker who is said to hate Garruk Wildspeaker, and whose discard ability is mentioned.

entities.name: Garruk Wildspeaker
entities.description: Planeswalker who is said to hate Liliana Vess; his beasts are mentioned.

entities.name: Zendikar
entities.description: Plane where a battle rages between its sentient humanoid adventurers and its hostile lands, with vampires as a third party.

entities.name: Adventurers of Zendikar
entities.description: Hardy humanoids who brave the elements to explore Zendikar's wild places, chasing treasure and mana-rich sites.

entities.name: Zendikar's lands
entities.description: The angry lands and their monsters, which strike back at the adventurers trampling and plundering the landscape.

entities.name: Vampires of Zendikar
entities.description: Hunting race of Zendikar that sides with neither adventurers nor the land; bloodchiefs sire new vampires and command nulls.

entities.name: Bloodchiefs
entities.description: Powerful vampires of Zendikar who alone can sire new vampires and can command small armies of nulls and lesser vampires.

entities.name: Nulls
entities.description: Strange, faceless thralls that result when a lesser vampire drains a victim on Zendikar.

entities.name: Guul Draz
entities.description: Gloomy continent of Zendikar that people stay out of because of its vampires.

entities.name: Avenger of Zendikar
entities.description: Huge angry plant monster that represents the land striking back.

entities.name: Archon of Justice
entities.description: Eventide Archon, a surreal humanoid figure riding a winged white stag, representing white-aligned principles.

events.summary: Zendikar's lands rise against the adventurers who trample and plunder them, striking back.
events.quote: On the other side of the battle are Zendikar's lands themselves.

events.summary: Vampires of Zendikar hunt by stealth, with bloodchiefs leveling outposts with their armies of nulls.
events.quote: Powerful vampires such as bloodchiefs possess overwhelming power and can command small armies of nulls and lesser vampires

relations.note: They hate each other and attack on sight.
relations.quote: Liliana Vess and Garruk Wildspeaker hate each other's guts.

relations.note: Bloodchiefs command small armies of nulls.
relations.quote: can command small armies of nulls and lesser vampires
Powerful vampires such as bloodchiefs possess overwhelming power

relations.note: The lands are fed up with the adventurers.
relations.quote: They have had it up to here
